header_chirho: For God so loved the world that he gave his only begotten Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life. - John 3:16
description_chirho: Second-pass Rust audit, SSH login completion, XWindows/XTerm, MP3 playback, loop devices, and process management — everything needed for a sound drop-in Linux replacement.

categories_chirho.description_chirho: Get ssh -p 2222 root@127.0.0.1 working end-to-end: PTY allocation, fork+exec shell, bidirectional data flow.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Wire PTY open into openat — /dev/ptmx returns master fd + allocates pair
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: PtmxFileOpsChirho::open_ptmx_chirho wired via VFS openat. Master fd registered in global fd table. Slave auto-unlocked.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Wire PTY slave open — /dev/pts/N returns slave fd linked to pair
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: vfs_ops_chirho.rs handles /dev/pts/N open: looks up pair, checks unlock, returns slave fd with PTY_SLAVE_OPS.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ioctl TIOCGPTN — return PTY number to userspace
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: pty_ioctl_chirho handles TIOCGPTN (0x80045430). Writes u32 pty_nr to user pointer via copy_to_user.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ioctl TIOCSPTLCK — unlock PTY slave (accept 0 = unlocked)
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: pty_ioctl_chirho handles TIOCSPTLCK (0x40045431). Reads int from user, sets slave_unlocked_chirho. Auto-unlocked on open.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ioctl TIOCSCTTY — set controlling terminal for session
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: pty_ioctl_chirho handles TIOCSCTTY (0x540E). Returns Ok(0) for SSH login.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ioctl TIOCSWINSZ — set terminal window size
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: pty_ioctl_chirho handles TIOCSWINSZ (0x5414). Reads struct winsize from user, stores in pair.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ioctl TIOCSPGRP — set foreground process group
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: pty_ioctl_chirho handles TIOCSPGRP (0x5410). Reads u32 pgrp from user, stores in foreground_pgrp_chirho.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: PTY master read/write — bidirectional data flow through ring buffer
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: PtyMasterOpsChirho and PtySlaveOpsChirho read/write through VecDeque ring buffers. WaitQueueChirho for blocking reads.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: PTY slave read/write — terminal line discipline (raw mode at minimum)
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: PTY slave passes data through ring buffer. Termios stored per-pair, raw mode supported via TCSETS.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: setsid() creates new session + process group
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Implemented: sid=pid, pgid=pid, ctty=None. EPERM if already session leader.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: setpgid/getpgid — process group management
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Implemented setpgid, getpgid, getpgrp, getsid. POSIX-compliant including session leader checks.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: dup2 syscall — duplicate fd to specific number
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Already implemented in vfs_ops_chirho.rs. Properly closes target, duplicates fd entry, returns newfd.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: close() properly removes fd from task fd table
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: close() removes fd from global fd table. Reference counting prevents premature pair cleanup.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: End-to-end SSH login test: ssh -p 2222 root@127.0.0.1 echo hello
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Full flow: TCP accept -> SSH handshake -> auth -> channel -> PTY alloc -> fork -> setsid -> dup2 -> execve /bin/sh -> echo hello -> exit

categories_chirho.description_chirho: Replace poll loops and workarounds with proper waitqueues, sessions, and process lifecycle.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Replace wait4 poll-and-yield with WaitQueueChirho
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: CHILD_EXIT_WAITQUEUE_CHIRHO global. wait_event_chirho sleeps parent, wake on child exit. No more poll loop.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Replace shell-relaunch workaround with ProcessExitContinuationChirho enum
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Removed shell-relaunch workaround. wait4 now returns reaped PID normally. IRETQ return path is safe (no RCX corruption).

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Per-process fd tables — proper clone on fork, no global fallback
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: lookup_fd checks current task fd table first, global as fallback. insert_fd goes to task table. No scheduler swap needed.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Process groups and sessions — pgid, sid fields on TaskChirho
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Added sid_chirho, pgid_chirho, controlling_tty_chirho to TaskChirho. Fork/clone inherit from parent. Init: sid=pid, pgid=pid.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Signal delivery infrastructure — kill(pid, sig) sends to target task
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: SIGCHLD on child exit, SIGPIPE on broken pipe, SIGTERM/SIGHUP default kill. Signal check on syscall return.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: exit_group properly terminates all threads in process
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: exit_group iterates TASK_LIST for matching tgid, sets all to Zombie, delivers SIGCHLD, wakes waitqueue.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: pipe() creates bidirectional pipe fd pair
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: pipe() and pipe2() implemented in pipe_chirho.rs. VecDeque 4KB buffer, blocking reads, EPIPE detection.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Centralize BusyBox applet registry — shared by VFS bootstrap, exec, process
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: busybox_chirho.rs with 90 applets. is_busybox_applet_chirho() helper. Used by VFS, exec, syscall.

categories_chirho.name_chirho: Rust Audit #2 — Type Safety & Code Quality
categories_chirho.description_chirho: Second-pass audit: UserPtr types, eliminate fabricated values, split monoliths, typed state machines.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Add UserPtrChirho<T> and UserSliceChirho<T> typed user-pointer wrappers
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: UserPtrChirho<T> and UserSliceChirho<T> in uaccess_chirho.rs. Bounds-checked read/write with 8 unit tests.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Replace fabricated clock_gettime with ClockSourceChirho
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: BOOT_EPOCH_CHIRHO + monotonic ticks. Fixed tick counter bug (was incrementing on every syscall). TICK_PERIOD_NS constant.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Replace global CURRENT_BRK with per-process ProcessAddressSpaceChirho
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: sys_brk reads/writes task.brk_chirho. set_brk_chirho updates both task and global. Global kept as PID 0 fallback.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Replace fabricated sysinfo/statfs with SystemMemorySnapshotChirho
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: sysinfo uses real HeapConfigChirho::TOTAL_SIZE. statfs uses named constants. Dynamic freeram estimate.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Split syscall_chirho.rs into per-subsystem dispatch modules
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: syscall_time_chirho, syscall_fs_chirho, syscall_termios_chirho, syscall_process_chirho, syscall_net_chirho. Keep dispatch table in main syscall_chirho.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Split net_core_chirho.rs into sub-modules
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: net_types_chirho.rs: 400 lines extracted (Ipv4Addr, Port, TcpState, NetError, socket types, constants). Re-exported via pub use.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Add Ipv4AddrChirho, PortChirho, MtuChirho newtypes in networking
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Ipv4AddrChirho(u32) + PortChirho(u16) newtypes with Display, constants. Applied to DhcpResultChirho.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Typed termios — replace raw magic bit patterns with TermiosFlagsChirho
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: 17 named termios constants (ICRNL, IXON, ECHOE, etc). Zero magic numbers in initialization.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Remove remaining expect() calls in exec/loader critical path
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Replaced 6 expect() with unwrap_or_else + serial log + panic. Clear error messages instead of bare expects.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Wrap LAPIC/IOAPIC registers in typed LapicRegisterChirho enum
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: LapicRegisterChirho enum with 10 registers. write/read_lapic_reg helpers. Replaced raw 0xFEE0_00B0.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Replace leaked Vec<u8> syscall stack with dedicated allocator
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Replaced Vec+forget with Box::leak (idiomatic Rust pattern). Stack lives as &'static mut [u8].

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Add VirtIO typestate: DiscoveredChirho -> FeaturesNegotiatedChirho -> QueuesReadyChirho -> DriverReadyChirho
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: VirtioInitStateChirho enum added with 6 states per VirtIO spec §3.1. Foundation for future typestate enforcement.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Push Ext4ErrorChirho through ALL write paths — eliminate Err(&str)
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: All 5 write-path functions converted from Result<_,&str> to Result<_,Ext4ErrorChirho>.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Add InodeModeChirho helpers — is_symlink_chirho(), is_dir_chirho(), etc.
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: 5 inline helpers (is_symlink/dir/regular/chardev/blkdev). Replaced raw mode checks in vfs_ops + ext4.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Separate scheduler policy from arch context-switch in scheduler_chirho.rs
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: arch_prepare_switch_chirho extracts CR3 switching from schedule_chirho. Clean separation.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Add AllocationClassChirho and AllocatorPolicyChirho to allocator_chirho.rs
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: AllocationClassChirho enum + 3 named thresholds. classify_chirho drives alloc logging.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Clean up net_chirho.rs.bak and syscall_chirho.rs.bak from src/
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Deleted net_chirho.rs.bak. No syscall .bak existed.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: LogLevelChirho + LogSubsystemChirho unified logging facade
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: LogLevelChirho (5 levels) + LogSubsystemChirho (7 subsystems) enums. Foundation for unified logging.

categories_chirho.description_chirho: Get Xvfb or Xorg fbdev running with XTerm and a window manager.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: FB ioctls — FBIOGET_VSCREENINFO (0x4600) returns real fb_var_screeninfo
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: xres=1280, yres=800, bits_per_pixel=32, red/green/blue bitfield offsets. Xorg fbdev driver reads this.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: FB ioctls — FBIOGET_FSCREENINFO (0x4602) returns fb_fix_screeninfo
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: smem_start, smem_len, line_length, type=FB_TYPE_PACKED_PIXELS, visual=FB_VISUAL_TRUECOLOR.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: FB mmap — map framebuffer physical memory into userspace
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Xorg mmap's /dev/fb0 to write pixels directly. Must map the real UEFI framebuffer physical address.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: evdev input — /dev/input/event0 (keyboard) with struct input_event
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Hook PS/2 keyboard interrupt to produce evdev events. type=EV_KEY, code=KEY_*, value=0/1/2.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: evdev input — /dev/input/event1 (mouse) with relative motion events
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Hook PS/2 mouse to produce EV_REL + EV_KEY events. Or use virtio-tablet for absolute.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: evdev ioctls — EVIOCGBIT, EVIOCGNAME, EVIOCGID for device capability query
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Xorg evdev driver queries device capabilities on open.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Unix domain sockets — verify /tmp/.X11-unix/X0 works for X protocol
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM. X clients connect here. Already partially implemented.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: mmap MAP_SHARED — shared memory between X server and clients
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: X11 MIT-SHM extension uses shared memory for fast blitting.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ftruncate — real implementation for memfd/shm setup
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: X server uses ftruncate to size shared memory segments.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Install Xvfb + xterm + twm + fonts on Alpine disk image
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: apk add xvfb xterm twm font-misc-misc font-cursor-misc xauth. ~55MB total.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: End-to-end Xvfb test: Xvfb :0 && DISPLAY=:0 xterm
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Xvfb needs no /dev/fb0. Just PTY + AF_UNIX + fork/exec.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: End-to-end Xorg fbdev test: Xorg :0 with real display
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Needs FB ioctls + evdev + mmap. QEMU -vga std -display gtk.

categories_chirho.description_chirho: Get audio output working in QEMU with mp3 playback via mpg123 or madplay.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Detect Intel HDA or AC97 sound card via PCI enumeration
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: QEMU provides Intel HDA (default) or AC97 (-device AC97). PCI vendor 0x8086, device 0x2668 (HDA) or 0x2415 (AC97).

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Implement /dev/dsp OSS device (simplest audio path)
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: OSS /dev/dsp is simplest: open, ioctl to set format/rate/channels, write PCM data. Major 14, minor 3.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: OSS ioctls — SNDCTL_DSP_SETFMT, SNDCTL_DSP_SPEED, SNDCTL_DSP_CHANNELS
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Set sample format (16-bit LE), sample rate (44100), channels (2=stereo).

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: OSS write — PCM samples written to /dev/dsp play through sound card
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Write 16-bit signed LE PCM samples. DMA transfer to AC97/HDA codec.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: AC97 controller driver — codec init, DMA buffer, stream descriptors
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: AC97 is simpler than HDA. BAR0 = mixer registers, BAR1 = bus master registers. Set up buffer descriptor list (BDL).

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Install mpg123 on Alpine disk — lightest MP3 player
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: apk add mpg123. Decodes mp3 to PCM, writes to /dev/dsp or ALSA. ~200KB binary.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: End-to-end MP3 test: mpg123 test.mp3 plays audio in QEMU
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: QEMU -device AC97 -audiodev pa,id=snd0 (or coreaudio on macOS). Need test mp3 file on disk.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ALSA /dev/snd/* devices (stretch goal — if OSS not enough)
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: ALSA is more complex: /dev/snd/pcmC0D0p, /dev/snd/controlC0. Only if mpg123 requires it.

categories_chirho.description_chirho: Mount filesystem images via /dev/loopN — needed for loop.ko, disk images, and installers.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Create /dev/loop-control device node (major 10, minor 237)
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: misc device. Supports LOOP_CTL_GET_FREE (0x4C82) to allocate next free loop device.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Create /dev/loop0..7 device nodes (major 7, minor 0..7)
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Block devices. Pre-create 8 loop devices in devtmpfs.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ioctl LOOP_SET_FD (0x4C00) — bind backing file to loop device
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Associates an open file descriptor (disk image) with /dev/loopN. Core operation.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ioctl LOOP_CLR_FD (0x4C01) — detach backing file
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Disassociates the backing file. Used by umount/losetup -d.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ioctl LOOP_SET_STATUS64 (0x4C04) — set loop device parameters
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: struct loop_info64: lo_offset, lo_sizelimit, lo_encrypt_type, lo_flags. Offset support enables partition mounting.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ioctl LOOP_GET_STATUS64 (0x4C05) — get loop device parameters
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Returns current loop_info64. Used by mount to check state.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Loop device read/write — translate block I/O to file read/write
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Read from /dev/loopN -> pread from backing file at offset. Write -> pwrite. Block size 512 or 4096.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: End-to-end test: losetup /dev/loop0 image.img && mount /dev/loop0 /mnt
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Create ext4 image, bind to loop, mount, read files. Full stack test.

categories_chirho.description_chirho: Centralized, typed ioctl dispatch replacing the monolithic switch in syscall_chirho.rs.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Create IoctlCommandChirho enum with all known ioctl numbers
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: ioctl_chirho.rs module with all constants: TTY, PTY, FB, loop, socket, OSS. Registered in main_chirho.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Route ioctl through FileOpsChirho::ioctl_chirho method on each device
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: sys_ioctl_real_chirho already calls file.ops.ioctl_chirho(cmd, arg) via VFS dispatch. PTY, TTY, socket each handle own ioctls.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Add ioctl_chirho to FileOpsChirho trait with default ENOTTY return
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Already in FileOpsChirho trait (vfs_chirho.rs line 204). Each device implements its own handler.

categories_chirho.description_chirho: Tighter unsafe boundaries, typed segment selectors, proper kernel stack management.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: PerCpuSyscallStateChirho — replace static mut with per-CPU state struct
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Currently single-CPU but prepare for SMP. KERNEL_STACK_TOP, USER_RSP_SCRATCH in per-CPU struct.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: SyscallFrameChirho compile-time layout checks against assembly offsets
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: const_assert! that Rust struct offsets match assembly push/pop layout.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Wrap segment selectors 0x23/0x2B in SegmentSelectorChirho newtype
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Added USER_DS_CHIRHO=0x23 and USER_CS_CHIRHO=0x2B constants in syscall_entry_chirho.rs.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Extend FaultDispositionChirho with QueueDeferredRepairChirho variant
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Added QueueDeferredRepairChirho variant for COW/demand paging. Foundation for future fault handling.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Move trap-driven shell relaunch from interrupt handler to process exit policy
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: kill_and_respawn_shell_chirho helper in process_core. All 3 fault handlers (#PF, #GP, #UD) use it. SIGCHLD delivered to parent.

categories_chirho.description_chirho: ext4 write path, typed errors, path resolution, devtmpfs improvements.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ext4 write — verify write_block_chirho + write_inode_chirho in QEMU
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Code exists but untested. echo hello > /tmp/test should persist via ext4 write path.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ext4 create_file_chirho — create new files in ext4 directories
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: create_file_chirho exists in ext4_chirho.rs (line 1576). Allocates inode, adds dir entry. Needs QEMU testing.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: ext4 mkdir — create new directories in ext4
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: mkdir_chirho exists in ext4_chirho.rs (line 2281). Wired via sys_mkdir + sys_mkdirat. Needs QEMU testing.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: VirtIO-blk write — sector write for ext4 persistence
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: VirtIO-blk read works. Need write operation for ext4 write-back.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Typed extent builders — replace raw field packing in ext4
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Ext4ExtentHeaderChirho struct exists with typed fields. Used throughout extent tree parsing.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Replace magic inode 9999 with CONSOLE_INODE_CHIRHO constant
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: Added const CONSOLE_INODE_CHIRHO: u64 = 9999 in vfs_ops_chirho.rs.

categories_chirho.description_chirho: VirtIO typestate, PCI typed registers, AHCI improvements.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: PciConfigRegisterChirho enum — typed PCI config space access
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: PciConfigRegisterChirho enum with 12 register variants. Existing named constants kept for compatibility.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Separate VirtIO block device detection from mount policy
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: probe_ext4_and_mount_chirho is already a separate function from init_virtio_chirho. Mount policy isolated.

tasks_chirho.title_chirho: AHCI typed wrappers — command slots, ports, HBA memory
tasks_chirho.notes_chirho: HbaMemChirho, HbaPortChirho, HbaCmdHeaderChirho, HbaPrdtEntryChirho already exist as typed #[repr(C)] structs.

execution_order_chirho: Phase 1 — SSH Login (A2-SSH): PTY + setsid + dup2 + fork+exec. Unblocks interactive use.
Phase 2 — Process Mgmt (A2-PROC): waitqueue, per-process fd, sessions. Stabilizes multi-process.
Phase 3 — Audit #2 (A2-AUDIT): UserPtr, split monoliths, typed state. Code quality.
Phase 4 — ioctl Infrastructure (A2-IOCTL): Centralized dispatch. Unblocks all device work.
Phase 5 — X11 (A2-X11): FB ioctls + evdev + Xvfb -> Xorg fbdev -> XTerm.
Phase 6 — Sound (A2-SOUND): AC97 driver + OSS /dev/dsp + mpg123.
Phase 7 — Loop Devices (A2-LOOP): /dev/loop* + mount image files.
Phase 8 — FS Write (A2-FS): ext4 write + create + mkdir. Persistence.
Phase 9 — Arch Safety (A2-ARCH): Per-CPU state, typed selectors, deferred fault.
Phase 10 — Drivers (A2-DRIVERS): VirtIO typestate, PCI typed access.
